blurb: The path to new exhibition “When the Earth Bends We Bend” has been a more than 15-year odyssey for Melissa Vogley Woods, with the chance discovery of a Russian-language video leading her down a rabbit hole that culminated in periods of study in the Finger Lakes region of New York and later in Rima, a tiny town in Northern Italy backed immediately up against the Alps.
